title: DNA Binding and Cleavage, Stopped-Flow Kinetic, Mechanistic, and Molecular Docking Studies of Cationic Ruthenium(II) Nitrosyl Complexes Containing "NS(4)" Core.
authors: Shereef, Hadeer A; Moemen, Yasmine S; Elshami, Fawzia I; El-Nahas, Ahmed M; Shaban, Shaban Y; van Eldik, Rudi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌配合物与ctDNA的结合及切割机制，含分子对接，但对象为小分子-DNA非转录因子体系，方法以实验为主、DFT/对接为辅，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: This work aimed to evaluate in vitro DNA binding mechanistically of cationic nitrosyl ruthenium complex [RuNOTSP](+) and its ligand (TSPH(2)) in detail, correlate the findings with cleavage activity, and draw conclusions about the impact of the metal center. Theoretical studies were performed for [RuNOTSP](+), TSPH(2), and its anion TSP(-2) using DFT/B3LYP theory to calculate optimized energy, binding energy, and chemical reactivity. Since nearly all medications function by attaching to a particular protein or DNA, the in vitro calf thymus DNA (ctDNA) binding studies of [RuNOTSP](+) and TSPH(2) with ctDNA were examined mechanistically using a variety of biophysical techniques. Fluorescence experiments showed that both compounds effectively bind to ctDNA through intercalative/electrostatic interactions via the DNA helix's phosphate backbone. The intrinsic binding constants (K(b)), (2.4 +/- 0.2) x 10(5) M(-1) ([RuNOTSP](+)) and (1.9 +/- 0.3) x 10(5) M(-1) (TSPH(2)), as well as the enhancement dynamic constants (K(D)), (3.3 +/- 0.3) x 10(4) M(-1) ([RuNOTSP](+)) and (2.6 +/- 0.2) x 10(4) M(-1) (TSPH(2)), reveal that [RuNOTSP](+) has a greater binding propensity for DNA compared to TSPH(2). Stopped-flow investigations showed that both [RuNOTSP](+) and TSPH(2) bind through two reversible steps: a fast second-order binding, followed by a slow first-order isomerization reaction via a static quenching mechanism. For the first and second steps of [RuNOTSP](+) and TSPH(2), the detailed binding parameters were established. The total binding constants for [RuNOTSP](+) (K(a) = 43.7 M(-1), K(d) = 2.3 x 10(-2) M(-1), DeltaG(0) = -36.6 kJ mol(-1)) and TSPH(2) (K(a) = 15.1 M(-1), K(d) = 66 x 10(-2) M, DeltaG(0) = -19 kJ mol(-1)) revealed that the relative reactivity is approximately ([RuNOTSP](+))/(TSPH(2)) = 3/1. The significantly negative DeltaG(0) values are consistent with a spontaneous binding reaction to both [RuNOTSP](+) and TSPH(2), with the former being very favorable. The findings showed that the Ru(II) center had an effect on the reaction rate but not on the mechanism and that the cationic [RuNOTSP](+) was a more highly effective DNA binder than the ligand TSPH(2) via strong electrostatic interaction with the phosphate end of DNA. Because of its higher DNA binding affinity, cationic [RuNOTSP](+) demonstrated higher cleavage efficiency towards the minor groove of pBR322 DNA via the hydrolytic pathway than TSPH(2), revealing the synergy effect of TSPH(2) in the form of the complex. Furthermore, the mode of interaction of both compounds with ctDNA has also been supported by molecular docking.
abstract_zh: 本工作旨在从机理上详细评估阳离子亚硝酰钌配合物[RuNOTSP](+)及其配体TSPH(2)的体外DNA结合特性，将研究结果与切割活性相关联，并得出关于金属中心影响的结论。采用DFT/B3LYP理论对[RuNOTSP](+)、TSPH(2)及其阴离子TSP(-2)进行了理论研究，计算了优化能量、结合能和化学反应活性。由于几乎所有药物都通过与特定蛋白质或DNA结合而发挥作用，因此利用多种生物物理技术，对[RuNOTSP](+)和TSPH(2)与小牛胸腺DNA (ctDNA)的体外结合研究进行了机理探讨。荧光实验表明，两种化合物均通过嵌入/静电相互作用，经由DNA螺旋的磷酸骨架有效结合ctDNA。内在结合常数(K(b))分别为(2.4 ± 0.2) x 10(5) M(-1)（[RuNOTSP](+)）和(1.9 ± 0.3) x 10(5) M(-1)（TSPH(2)），以及增强动态常数(K(D))分别为(3.3 ± 0.3) x 10(4) M(-1)（[RuNOTSP](+)）和(2.6 ± 0.2) x 10(4) M(-1)（TSPH(2)），表明[RuNOTSP](+)对DNA的结合倾向高于TSPH(2)。停流研究表明，[RuNOTSP](+)和TSPH(2)均通过两个可逆步骤结合：首先是快速的二级结合，随后是通过静态猝灭机制进行的缓慢一级异构化反应。针对[RuNOTSP](+)和TSPH(2)的第一步和第二步，确定了详细的结合参数。总结合常数显示，[RuNOTSP](+)（K(a) = 43.7 M(-1)，K(d) = 2.3 x 10(-2) M(-1)，DeltaG(0) = -36.6 kJ mol(-1)）和TSPH(2)（K(a) = 15.1 M(-1)，K(d) = 66 x 10(-2) M，DeltaG(0) = -19 kJ mol(-1)）的相对反应活性约为([RuNOTSP](+))/(TSPH(2)) = 3/1。显著负值的DeltaG(0)与[RuNOTSP](+)和TSPH(2)的自发结合反应一致，且前者更为有利。研究结果表明，Ru(II)中心对反应速率有影响，但不影响反应机制，且阳离子[RuNOTSP](+)通过与DNA磷酸末端的强静电相互作用，成为比配体TSPH(2)更高效的DNA结合剂。由于其更高的DNA结合亲和力，阳离子[RuNOTSP](+)通过水解途径对pBR322 DNA小沟的切割效率高于TSPH(2)，揭示了TSPH(2)在配合物形式中的协同效应。此外，分子对接也支持了两种化合物与ctDNA的相互作用模式。
